threats.title: Secret committed to Git history
threats.description: A secret such as an API key or password is committed and stays in Git history. Leaked keys are exploited quickly and history is permanent.
threats.mitigation: gitleaks in the pre-commit hook and in CI; push protection; rotate any exposed key.

threats.title: Workflow tampering through a pull request
threats.description: A malicious pull request edits a workflow file so it runs attacker code with access to secrets. This gives the attacker the CI system’s full privileges.
threats.mitigation: No secrets for fork PRs; least-privilege GITHUB_TOKEN; CODEOWNERS and required review on workflow files.

threats.title: Hijacked third-party GitHub Action
threats.description: A third-party action or its tag is hijacked or changed. One compromised action runs inside every build.
threats.mitigation: Pin actions to full commit SHAs; Dependabot updates; allow-list of actions.
